newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt debt service to currency receipts ratio up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt debt service to currency receipts ratio up.

text.p: Egypt spent 10.9 percent of its foreign exchange receipts on servicing external debt in the financial year 1995/6, up from 10.2 percent in the previous year, a central bank report said on Tuesday.
The financial years end on June 30.
The ratio of debt service to receipts from exports and services also increased, to 13.6 percent from 13.1 percent.
The total cost of foreign debt servicing was $2.042 billion in 1995/96, against $1.900 billion in 1994/95.
Egypt's external debt fell to $31.043 billion at the end of 1995/6, from $32.965 billion one year earlier.
